b: SawStop apparently launched new table saw accessories, including workpiece guides that act like rolling featherboards.
A lot of people are talking about the similarities between the SawStop WorkTrack Guides and an iconic product from JessEm.
Here are the JessEm Clear-Cut table saw guides.
Count me in the “it looks like SawStop ripped off JessEm” group.
It’s not uncommon for tool brands to be inspired by each other’s designs and innovations. In this case, it’s ironic given SawStop and its history of infringement lawsuits.
Even if there’s no infringement, this isn’t a good look for SawStop.
SawStop’s table saw work guides are said to be made in China. JessEm says theirs are made in Canada.
